name: 64. Anthropic-on-Vertex Passthrough Usage + Stream Terminal Detection (vertex-anthropic-passthrough)
description:
Vertex passthrough classified every response by path only loosely, and parsed all of them with the Gemini usage parser. Anthropic on Vertex is served from the anthropic publisher via :rawPredict / :streamRawPredict and speaks Anthropic Messages shapes, so the Gemini parser found no usage: passthrough calls to Claude on Vertex logged zero tokens and zero cost. PR #6639 dispatches on the publisher segment (anthropic -> Anthropic parsers, mistralai and /endpoints/openapi/ -> OpenAI parsers, everything else -> Gemini) and teaches the stream terminal detector three new shapes: Anthropic's message_stop, Google's {"error":{code|status}} envelope, and streams with no SSE framing at all (:streamGenerateContent?alt=json sends one JSON array, so the \n\n frame loop never fired and the stream hung until the idle timeout).

Every row is [PREVIEW]-tagged (run with INCLUDE_PREVIEW=1): the Vertex passthrough URL is project-scoped, so {{vertexProject}} must be overridden from its replace-me-project default, and {{vertexLocation}} must be a region where Claude is served (global or us-east5 for most accounts).

The usage assertions are the point of the folder and are made by the dbverify reporter, not by the test scripts: each row sends x-bf-expect-cost with an x-request-id, and dbverify requires the resulting logs row to have cost>0 and total_tokens>0. The in-script assertions only establish that usage was on the wire for the parser to find.

Closes two HARNESS_COVERAGE_BACKLOG entries: Vertex :streamRawPredict endpoint for SSE streaming, and anthropic_version: "vertex-2023-10-16" in body.

item.name: [PREVIEW] vertex :rawPredict Anthropic passthrough records usage via the Anthropic parser - vertex-anthropic-passthrough

exec: // Anthropic on Vertex is served from the anthropic publisher via :rawPredict, whose payloads are
// Anthropic Messages shapes - not Gemini ones. Before PR #6639 every Vertex passthrough response
// went through ExtractGeminiPassthroughUsage, which finds nothing in a Messages body, so the log
// row persisted zero tokens and zero cost. The cost/token assertion is performed by the dbverify
// reporter against the logs row keyed on x-request-id (x-bf-expect-cost).
var body = pm.response.text();
pm.test('vertex anthropic rawPredict: 2xx - vertex-anthropic-passthrough', function () {
pm.expect(pm.response.code, 'failed: ' + body).to.be.below(400);
if (pm.response.code >= 400) { return; }
var j = pm.response.json() || {};
var dump = JSON.stringify(j).slice(0, 400);
pm.test('vertex anthropic rawPredict: body forwarded verbatim as an Anthropic Messages reply - vertex-anthropic-passthrough', function () {
pm.expect(j.type, dump).to.eql('message');
pm.expect(j.content, dump).to.be.an('array');
pm.test('vertex anthropic rawPredict: usage is on the wire for the parser to read - vertex-anthropic-passthrough', function () {
pm.expect(j.usage, dump).to.be.an('object');
pm.expect(Number(j.usage.input_tokens), dump).to.be.above(0);
pm.expect(Number(j.usage.output_tokens), dump).to.be.above(0);

item.name: [PREVIEW] vertex :streamRawPredict Anthropic passthrough terminates on message_stop and records usage - vertex-anthropic-passthrough

exec: // Anthropic streams end on message_stop and carry no finishReason, so the Gemini terminal
// detector never fired and the passthrough stream sat on the upstream body until the idle
// timeout. PR #6639 makes message_stop terminal (message_delta deliberately is not - it holds
// the final usage) and routes usage through AnthropicPassthroughStreamUsage.ObserveEvent.
// dbverify asserts cost>0 && tokens>0 on the logs row keyed by x-request-id.
var body = pm.response.text() || '';
pm.test('vertex anthropic streamRawPredict: stream succeeded - vertex-anthropic-passthrough', function () {
pm.expect(pm.response.code, 'stream request failed: ' + body.slice(0, 400)).to.equal(200);
pm.expect(body, 'no SSE frames: ' + body.slice(0, 400)).to.include('data:');
if (pm.response.code >= 400) { return; }
pm.test('vertex anthropic streamRawPredict: frames forwarded unmodified - vertex-anthropic-passthrough', function () {
pm.expect(body, 'no message_start frame: ' + body.slice(0, 400)).to.include('message_start');
pm.expect(body, 'no content_block_delta frames: ' + body.slice(0, 400)).to.include('content_block_delta');

pm.test('vertex anthropic streamRawPredict: final usage is on the wire - vertex-anthropic-passthrough', function () {
pm.expect(body, 'no output_tokens in the terminal message_delta: ' + body.slice(-400)).to.include('output_tokens');
